description: Seed rows and principals for the demo domain. Every example application persists exactly these rows into its own store and plans for exactly these principals. Realistic shapes only — the hostile ones live in ../conformance/seeds.json.

applicationFilter.description: The application's OWN predicate, never expressed in policy. Usage shape 5 ANDs it with the adapter-produced filter. Kept here rather than hardcoded in every example so validate-demo.sh can recompute it and prove shape 5 discriminates: applying this predicate alone, or the adapter's filter alone, must both give the wrong answer.
